sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for your kind words. We truly value our long cooperation with your family foundry and the care your team puts into every PH-100 housing. We also take your point on metal-industry wages seriously.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3). We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

To give you more planning security, we propose a longer 24-month term, valid from 1 December 2026, in one of two forms:
- Option A: EUR 48.60 per unit, payment 60 days net.
- Option B: EUR 47.04 per unit, payment 30 days net.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

We look forward to hearing from you and to continuing our good work together.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your kind words and the proposal for a 24-month contract, which indeed provides valuable planning security for both sides.
While it is our strict policy not to share internal cost breakdowns, we have carefully considered your should-cost estimate and are prepared to offer €50.90 per unit for the 24-month term with 30-day payment.
We value our 12-year relationship highly and trust this significant concession demonstrates our commitment to continuing our successful cooperation.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your reply and for moving on the price. We appreciate it, and we value our 12 years of working together just as highly as you do.

We have compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342). With that in mind, we would like to take a step toward you and keep the 24-month package you welcomed. We can offer three options:

- Option A: EUR 48.99 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027
- Option B: EUR 48.93 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026
- Option C: EUR 48.60 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to hearing from you and to continuing our cooperation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have verified the past order prices you cited and have factored them into our revised offer.
In response to your technical question, the current casting process for the PH-100 is already fully optimized for your requirements, so a cheaper variant is not feasible.
Valuing our 12-year relationship, we are pleased to offer €50.30 per unit for the 24-month contract starting 1 December 2026 with 60-day payment terms.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you, and your team, for the careful reply. We appreciate that you moved on the price and answered our question on payment days, and that you checked the price history and past order prices so thoroughly. Thank you also for confirming that the PH-100 is cast strictly to our drawing.

We noticed that your message contained two versions, with different prices, payment terms and start dates. To keep things simple, we have moved most of the way towards you and set out two options, one for each start date:

- Option A: EUR 49.59 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 49.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

After twelve years together, we value this partnership greatly and are confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your kind letter and for answering it personally. After twelve years together, that means a great deal to us. We also appreciate that you have moved on price and taken up our proposal on the effective date.

Your e-mail contains two sets of terms: €49.70 per unit from 1 December 2026, and €49.90 per unit from 1 April 2027. We have built on the first. We have come most of the way towards you, because this partnership matters to us and we would like to give both our houses security for the next two years.

Our proposal:
- Option A: EUR 49.65 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

If this works for you, we would be glad to finalise the agreement together.

With warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
